RE-MEASURED AT 14:47Z. 37 UNPROBED -> 5. The body of this bead is now stale and this note supersedes its numbers.

Population unchanged: 38 private-constructor case classes in main sources. COVERED BY A CONSTRUCTION PROBE: 33. REMAINING: 5, named, with modules:

  BlockedSidecarLayout        codec/src/main/scala/storymodel4s/codec/sidecar.scala
  StructuralMemberEstimate    align/src/main/scala/storymodel4s/align/cost.scala
  StructuralMemberExclusion   align/src/main/scala/storymodel4s/align/cost.scala
  StructuralReduction         align/src/main/scala/storymodel4s/align/cost.scala
  StructuralReductionReceipt  align/src/main/scala/storymodel4s/align/cost.scala

Four of the five are in ONE FILE, align/cost.scala, and they are the structural-channel types -- the ones embed-grakern feeds. That is a tighter and more interesting remainder than 37 scattered types: it is one seam, and it is the seam whose distances we have just established were never semantic.

METHOD, so the next actor can re-run it rather than trust me:
  grep -rhoE 'case class [A-Z][A-Za-z0-9_]* private' --include='*.scala' */src/main | awk '{print $3}' | sort -u
  then, per type, check whether any suite containing typeChecks/typeCheckErrors names it.
This OVER-counts coverage: a suite that merely MENTIONS a type counts it as covered, so 33 is an upper bound and some of those probes may be weak or vacuous. The 5 are certain; the 33 are 'at least referenced by a probe suite'. Whoever finishes this should verify a sample of the 33 with a mutation rather than assume.

WHY THE BEAD WAS STALE: last progress note was 03:28Z, eleven hours before this one, while three probe suites landed in between (c5a119a, b0831b1, 0b414b4). The work moved and the bead did not. Same rot I spent today clearing in the candidate ledger, in my own bead, unnoticed until an hourly check made me look.

STATUS STAYS doing AND ASSIGNEE STAYS ME. Five types in two files is a finishable remainder, not an abandoned bead.
